mapper.sql: select t.*, ct.task_name camera_task_name, ct.status capture_task_status, ct.job_type capture_job_type, ct.execute_time capture_execute_time, ct.cron_expression capture_cron_expression, cp.id preset_id, cp.point_index, d.device_name, d.device_sn, a.area_id, a.area_name, p.park_name, m.model_name from sxz_disease_auto_task t left join camera_task ct on ct.task_id = t.camera_task_id left join camera_preset cp on cp.id = ct.preset_id left join iot_device d on d.device_id = cp.device_id left join location l on l.location_id = d.location_id left join area a on a.area_id = l.area_id left join park p on p.park_id = a.park_id left join xwq_ai_model m on m.model_id = t.model_id
mapper.insert: insert into sxz_disease_auto_task (task_name, camera_task_id, consume_mode, park_id, device_id, model_id, crop_type, max_retry_count, task_status, run_state, invalid_reason, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskName}, #{cameraTaskId}, #{consumeMode}, #{parkId}, #{deviceId}, #{modelId}, #{cropType}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{taskStatus}, 'IDLE', #{invalidReason}, #{remark}, 'system', now(), 'system', now())
mapper.update: update sxz_disease_auto_task set task_name = #{taskName}, camera_task_id = #{cameraTaskId}, consume_mode = #{consumeMode}, park_id = #{parkId}, device_id = #{deviceId}, model_id = #{modelId}, crop_type = #{cropType}, max_retry_count = #{maxRetryCount}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, invalid_reason = #{invalidReason}, next_run_time = null, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' and run_state = 'IDLE'
update sxz_disease_auto_task set task_status = #{taskStatus}, next_run_time = null, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' and run_state = 'IDLE'
mapper.select: where t.del_flag = '0' and t.task_status = '0' and t.camera_task_id is not null and (t.run_state = 'IDLE' or t.execution_lock_time < date_sub(now(), interval 30 minute)) order by coalesce(t.last_run_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), t.task_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update sxz_disease_auto_task set run_state = 'RUNNING', execution_token = #{token}, execution_lock_time = now(), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' and task_status = '0' and (run_state = 'IDLE' or execution_lock_time < date_sub(now(), interval 30 minute))

update sxz_disease_auto_task set run_state = 'RUNNING', execution_token = #{token}, execution_lock_time = now(), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' and (run_state = 'IDLE' or execution_lock_time < date_sub(now(), interval 30 minute))

update sxz_disease_auto_task set run_state = 'IDLE', execution_token = null, execution_lock_time = null, last_run_time = #{lastRunTime}, next_run_time = null, last_run_status = #{lastRunStatus}, last_run_message = #{lastRunMessage}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and execution_token = #{executionToken}
mapper.insert: insert into sxz_disease_auto_task_run (task_id, camera_task_id, device_id, park_id, model_id, task_name, trigger_type, run_status, start_time, source_count, recognize_count, success_count, fail_count, skip_count, create_by, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{cameraTaskId}, #{deviceId}, #{parkId}, #{modelId}, #{taskName}, #{triggerType}, #{runStatus}, #{startTime}, #{sourceCount}, #{recognizeCount}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{skipCount}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update sxz_disease_auto_task_run set run_status = #{runStatus}, end_time = #{endTime}, source_count = #{sourceCount}, recognize_count = #{recognizeCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, skip_count = #{skipCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = now() where run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from sxz_disease_auto_task where del_flag = '0') taskCount, (select count(*) from sxz_disease_auto_task where del_flag = '0' and task_status = '0') enabledTaskCount, (select count(*) from sxz_disease_auto_task where del_flag = '0' and task_status = '1') disabledTaskCount, (select count(*) from sxz_disease_auto_task where del_flag = '0' and last_run_status in ('FAILED','PARTIAL')) abnormalTaskCount, (select count(*) from sxz_disease_auto_task_run where start_time >= curdate()) todayRunCount, (select count(distinct r.record_id) from xwq_ai_record r where r.record_type = '病虫害' and r.record_mode = '自动定时' and r.create_time >= curdate()) todayImageCount, (select count(*) from xwq_ai_record r join xwq_ai_disease d on d.record_id = r.record_id where r.record_type = '病虫害' and r.record_mode = '自动定时' and r.create_time >= curdate() and trim(d.disease_name) in ('健康','健康叶片')) todayHealthyCount, (select count(*) from xwq_ai_record r join xwq_ai_disease d on d.record_id = r.record_id where r.record_type = '病虫害' and r.record_mode = '自动定时' and r.create_time >= curdate() and trim(d.disease_name) not in ('健康','健康叶片')) todayDiseaseCount, coalesce((select round(sum(case when trim(d.disease_name) not in ('健康','健康叶片') then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) from xwq_ai_record r join xwq_ai_disease d on d.record_id = r.record_id where r.record_type = '病虫害' and r.record_mode = '自动定时' and r.create_time >= curdate()), 0) todayDetectionRate, coalesce((select round(sum(success_count) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(success_count + fail_count), 0), 2) from sxz_disease_auto_task_run where start_time >= curdate()), 0) todaySuccessRate, (select max(r.create_time) from xwq_ai_record r where r.record_type = '病虫害' and r.record_mode = '自动定时') latestRecognizeTime
select park_id value, park_name label from park order by park_id

select d.device_id value, d.device_name label from iot_device d left join location l on l.location_id = d.location_id left join area a on a.area_id = l.area_id a.park_id = #{parkId} order by d.device_id

select model_id value, model_name label from xwq_ai_model where model_status = 1 and model_url is not null and trim(model_url) != '' and lower(trim(model_type)) in ('病虫害','disease','disease_recognition') order by model_id
mapper.sql: select ct.task_id value, ct.task_name label, ct.status, ct.job_type, ct.execute_time, ct.cron_expression, ct.count capture_count, cp.id preset_id, cp.point_index, d.device_id, d.device_name, d.device_sn, a.area_id, a.area_name, p.park_id, p.park_name from camera_task ct left join camera_preset cp on cp.id = ct.preset_id left join iot_device d on d.device_id = cp.device_id left join location l on l.location_id = d.location_id left join area a on a.area_id = l.area_id left join park p on p.park_id = a.park_id
mapper.select: order by case when ct.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end, ct.create_time desc, ct.task_id desc
select a.park_id from iot_device d left join location l on l.location_id = d.location_id left join area a on a.area_id = l.area_id where d.device_id = #{deviceId} limit 1

select count(*) from xwq_ai_model where model_id = #{modelId} and model_status = 1 and model_url is not null and trim(model_url) != '' and lower(trim(model_type)) in ('病虫害','disease','disease_recognition')

select r.id source_image_id, r.url image_url, #{task.modelId} model_id_snapshot, coalesce(r.capture_time, r.create_time) capture_time from image_record r where r.task_id = #{task.cameraTaskId} and r.url is not null and trim(r.url) != '' and not exists (select 1 from sxz_disease_auto_task_item i where i.task_id = #{task.taskId} and i.source_image_id = r.id) order by coalesce(r.capture_time, r.create_time) asc, r.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into sxz_disease_auto_task_item (task_id, run_id, source_image_id, model_id_snapshot, capture_time, item_status, attempt_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{runId}, #{sourceImageId}, #{modelIdSnapshot}, #{captureTime}, #{itemStatus}, 0, now(), now())

insert into xwq_ai_image (image_name, image_url, image_ai_type, image_source, image_source_id, image_size, image_format, park_id, plot_id, device_id, image_status, image_a, image_b, create_time, update_time) select concat('auto_', #{task.taskId}, '_', r.id, '_', substring_index(r.url, '/', -1)), r.url, 'disease', '摄像头', r.id, r.file_size, lower(substring_index(r.url, '.', -1)), a.park_id, a.area_id, r.device_id, 0, #{task.cropType}, cast(#{task.taskId} as char), now(), now() from image_record r left join iot_device d on d.device_id = r.device_id left join location l on l.location_id = d.location_id left join area a on a.area_id = l.area_id where r.id = #{item.sourceImageId} and not exists (select 1 from xwq_ai_image i where i.image_source = '摄像头' and i.image_source_id = r.id and i.image_ai_type = 'disease')
mapper.select: select image_id from xwq_ai_image where image_source = '摄像头' and image_source_id = #{sourceImageId} and image_ai_type = 'disease' order by image_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update xwq_ai_image set image_status = #{imageStatus}, update_time = now() where image_id = #{imageId}
update sxz_disease_auto_task_item set ai_image_id = #{aiImageId}, item_status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, start_time = #{startTime}, update_time = now() where item_id = #{itemId}

update sxz_disease_auto_task_item set record_id = #{recordId}, disease_id = #{diseaseId}, item_status = 'SUCCESS', attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_retry_time = null, finish_time = #{finishTime}, error_message = null, update_time = now() where item_id = #{itemId}

update sxz_disease_auto_task_item set ai_image_id = #{aiImageId}, item_status = 'FAILED', finish_time = #{finishTime}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_retry_time = null, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = now() where item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.sql: select i.item_id, i.task_id, coalesce(t.task_name, '自动定时识别') task_name, i.run_id, r.record_id, d.disease_id, img.image_id, img.image_name, img.image_url, coalesce(d.disease_result_img_url, img.image_result_url) result_image_url, d.disease_name, d.disease_confidence confidence, d.warning_level, d.disease_result, d.disease_desc, d.disease_advice, r.park_id, p.park_name, r.device_id, dev.device_name, r.model_id, m.model_name, r.crop_type, r.record_mode, r.create_time recognize_time from xwq_ai_record r join xwq_ai_disease d on d.record_id = r.record_id left join sxz_disease_auto_task_item i on i.record_id = r.record_id and i.disease_id = d.disease_id and i.item_status = 'SUCCESS' left join sxz_disease_auto_task t on t.task_id = i.task_id left join xwq_ai_image img on img.image_id = coalesce(i.ai_image_id, r.image_id, d.image_id) left join park p on p.park_id = r.park_id left join iot_device dev on dev.device_id = r.device_id left join xwq_ai_model m on m.model_id = r.model_id
mapper.select: where i.item_id = #{itemId} and i.item_status = 'SUCCESS' and r.record_type = '病虫害' and r.record_mode = '自动定时'
select i.*, img.image_url from sxz_disease_auto_task_item i left join xwq_ai_image img on img.image_id = i.ai_image_id where i.run_id = #{runId} order by i.item_id
